# to_ranges

to_ranges(nums) sorts the distinct integers in nums and joins them with commas, writing every run of 4 OR MORE consecutive integers as first-last. Inside a range, a negative endpoint is written in parentheses; outside a range, numbers are written plainly. to_ranges([]) == "".

Examples:

- `to_ranges([3, 6, -7]) == '-7,3,6'`
- `to_ranges([13, -5, 7, 9, 11, 8, -6, -3, -1, -7]) == '-7,-6,-5,-3,-1,7,8,9,11,13'`
